settings.heading: Is MONDE AMIE a French company?
settings.row_content: No, we are not a French company. We are officially a 100% Dutch company. However our name is French as MONDE AMIE has been originally created in Saint-Tropez. Many of our designs are inspired by de Côte d'Azur. We are heavily influenced by French culture and fashion.

settings.heading: How do I contact MONDE AMIE ?
settings.row_content: Please note that messages sent via Instagram DMs may not be guaranteed a response, so for urgent matters, kindly email us at contact@mondeamie.com and we will get back to you promptly.

settings.heading: How long does it take for my package to arrive?
settings.row_content: We always try to fulfil orders as fast as possible. Expect to receive your package within 7 business days.

settings.heading: How do I return a product?
settings.row_content: If you have any questions about returning you can send an email to contact@mondeamie.com

settings.heading: My product has arrived damaged.
settings.row_content: Reach out to us trough contact@mondeamie.com within 2 days with a foto of your damaged goods and we will solve your problem promptly.
